$comment: Stage I (HANDOFF_SC2_CORE_RESTRUCTURE_CONTINUATION_2026-09-15.md §13) screen registry. One row per legacy MK2 VS Code surface (command, custom editor, view, status bar item, or setting group). mk3.status is decided by reading MK3 source/tests, not by name matching. Complements migration/vscode-workflows.json (14 CLI+VSCode workflows) with per-screen host (VS Code / Electron / web) coverage and UI-part evidence from packages/ui.

rows.notes: candidate-vscode-settings (post-release): none of the 25 legacy keys is expected to survive literally; source/discovery configuration moved into the generic persisted content-source model (modkit.contentSources UI) and provider-level auto-discovery, but no live artifact ties each old key 1:1 to its new home.

legacy.title: (unnamed) host status item
legacy.behavior: Left-aligned status bar item summarizing current mod/resolution state; clicking opened diagnostics.

rows.notes: Present as a generic host-status status bar item wired to modkit.showHostProfile.

legacy.title: Game Codecs
legacy.behavior: Tree of the effective per-game codec contribution set (requires/defaults/suggests), grouped by codec kind, with toggles for non-required contributions.

rows.notes: candidate-vscode-views (already-equivalent): folded into the generic Extensions view (modkit.extensions), which lists/toggles codec contributions per installed extension.

legacy.title: Modkit
legacy.behavior: Root activity-bar welcome/status view: current install, loaded mods, and quick actions.

rows.notes: candidate-vscode-views (already-equivalent): folded into the native Host view (modkit.host).

legacy.title: Modkit: Validate Mod GameData (LSP)
legacy.behavior: Ran a whole-mod GameData XML validation pass through the SC2 language server and reported diagnostics across every affected file.

rows.notes: candidate-vscode-authoring (migration/vscode-workflows.json): apps/vscode/package.json and bundled-contributes.v1.json declare zero VS Code languages, and no command of this name is registered in extension.ts. The underlying SC2 Data provider has diagnostics (modules/data language provider), but no whole-mod validate command wires it in VS Code today.
rows.fixture: a SC2 mod with a broken cross-file GameData reference

legacy.title: Modkit: Validate Mod Strings (LSP)
legacy.behavior: Cross-checked GameData catalog string references against the mod's GameStrings files and reported missing/unused keys.

rows.notes: Same gap as gamedata.validateMod (candidate-vscode-authoring): no command registered, no declared VS Code language contribution to hang it from.
rows.fixture: a SC2 mod GameData catalog referencing a missing GameStrings key

legacy.title: Modkit: Verify Galaxy Script
legacy.behavior: Ran the Galaxy compiler/checker over the active .galaxy file (and its Root ordering/dependency chain) and reported errors.

rows.notes: candidate-vscode-authoring (post-release): no verifyGalaxyScript command in extension.ts; Galaxy diagnostics exist as live-as-you-type LSP diagnostics (per HANDOFF §3.1) but there is no explicit "verify" batch command/CLI-through-VS-Code path proven live (gap-cli-scripts-galaxy-live-proof).

legacy.title: GameData language/LSP tuning settings
legacy.behavior: Toggled LSP-backed GameData validation vs. a simpler in-process mode, tuned diagnostics/update debounce delays, and pointed at a custom XSD schema path.

rows.notes: candidate-vscode-settings (post-release): no equivalent keys declared; the generic language workspace (apps/vscode/src/language-session.ts) has its own internal bounds (per HANDOFF §3.8-3.9) but no user-facing debounce/XSD-path setting was found.

legacy.title: UI/display preference settings
legacy.behavior: Chose the extension's display locale, whether the MOD tree view was visible, the relation graph's max hop count, and the model viewer renderer backend (auto/three/webgl).

rows.notes: candidate-vscode-settings (post-release): apps/vscode/package.json config keys are all extension-management keys (defaultEditorForTextFormats, disabledExtensions, etc.); none of these four legacy UI-preference keys has a declared replacement.
